addLiquidityV2(address,uint256,uint256,a.details: Creates a new pool if one doesn't exist

params.ethAmount: Amount of ETH to add as liquidity
params.recipient: Address to receive the LP tokens
params.token: The ERC20 token address to pair with ETH
params.tokenAmount: Amount of tokens to add as liquidity

returns.pairAddress: The address of the created or existing pair

addLiquidityV2WithTargetMarketCap(addres.details: Calculates optimal ETH and token amounts to maintain target market cap

params.ethAmount: Available ETH to add as liquidity
params.ethPriceUSD: Current ETH price in USD (18 decimals)
params.recipient: Address to receive the LP tokens
params.targetMarketCap: Target market cap in USD (18 decimals)
params.token: The ERC20 token address to pair with ETH
params.tokenAmount: Available tokens to add as liquidity

returns.pairAddress: The address of the created or existing pair

addLiquidityV3(address,uint256,uint256,a.details: Creates a new pool if one doesn't exist, mints a new NFT position

params.ethAmount: Amount of ETH to add as liquidity
params.recipient: Address to receive the position NFT
params.token: The ERC20 token address to pair with ETH
params.tokenAmount: Amount of tokens to add as liquidity

returns.amount0: The amount of token0 actually used
returns.amount1: The amount of token1 actually used
returns.tokenId: The ID of the minted NFT position

addLiquidityV4(address,uint256,uint256,a.details: Creates a new V4 pool if one doesn't exist

params.ethAmount: Amount of ETH to add as liquidity
params.recipient: Address to receive the liquidity position
params.token: The ERC20 token address to pair with ETH
params.tokenAmount: Amount of tokens to add as liquidity

params._marginRecipient: Recipient address for margin ETH after adding liquidity
params._permit2: Permit2 contract address for token approvals
params._universalRouter: Universal router address for V4 operations

params.path: Array of token addresses representing the swap path

returns.amounts: Array of output amounts for each step in the path

returns.tickSpacing: The tick spacing for the fee tier

onERC721Received(address,address,uint256.details: Required for receiving Uniswap V3 position NFTs

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

pause().details: Prevents execution of functions with whenNotPaused modifier

unpause().details: Allows execution of functions with whenNotPaused modifier
